v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: The system must not return any slot starting v2_human 15 on Friday.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: The system must not apply the Friday cutoff to non-Friday days.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: C1 From task 5 can be used here

v2_human_g3_exception:
Same as task 5, except,
- day is no longer ignored.
- Friday specific rule now exists: meetings on Fridays must not start v2_human 15.
- This rule is added on top of all previous rules (walk hours, lunch, event conflicts, 15 min grid, ...).

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: On Fridays, a meeting must not start v2_human 15.
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: 15 is allowed; times later than 15 are excluded.
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The Friday rule applies in addition to all existing constraints (walk hours, launch/conflicts, etc).
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: The day input must be recognizable as Friday for the Friday rule to trigger.

v2_human_g3_goal: Same as task 5, plus: On Fridays, valid meetings must not start v2_human 15:00
v2_human_g3_input:
events: Same as v1_human
meeting_duration: Same as v1_human
day: day is now used to detect Friday. The Friday cutoff applies only when the day is recognized as Friday.

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: The system must not return any slot starting v2_human 15 on a Friday.
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: The system must not apply the Friday cutoff to non-Friday days.

v2_human_g3_output: Same as v1_human + on Fridays, returned start times must be ≤ 15:00.

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: If day is Friday, every returned slot must have start time < 15.
